```{r}
library(clustinvar)
library(lavaan)
library(sirt)
```
```{r}
dat_neu <- openesm::get_dataset("0001_fried")$data[, c("id", 
"scheduled", "issued", "response", "difficulties_relaxing", "irritable", "worry", "nervous")]

head(dat_neu)
```
```{r}
dat_neu <- dplyr::rename(dat_neu,
              neu.1 = difficulties_relaxing,
              neu.2 = irritable,
              neu.3 = worry,
              neu.4 = nervous)
```

```{r}
model <- '
level: 1
fw =~ neu.1 + neu.2 + neu.3 + neu.4
neu.1 ~~ neu.2

level:2
neu.1 ~~ neu.2 + neu.3 + neu.4
neu.2 ~~ neu.3 + neu.4
neu.3 ~~ neu.4
'

items <- c("neu.1", "neu.2", "neu.3", "neu.4")

fit <- cfa(
  model,
  data = dat_neu,
  cluster = "id",
  estimator = "MLR",
  missing = "FIML"
)
```
```{r}
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE)
```
```{r}
saveRDS(summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE), "neu_fit_summary.rds")
```

```{r}
config_results2 <- cluster_fit(
  fit,
  fit_measures = c("chisq.scaled", "rmsea.robust", "cfi.robust", "srmr"),
  constraint = "none",
  check.gradient = FALSE,
  warn = FALSE,
  return_lavaan = TRUE
)
```
```{r}
saveRDS(config_results2, "neu_config_results2.rds")
```

```{r}
good_clusters <- config_results$cluster[which(config_results2$pvalue.swain.adj > .05 & config_results2$admissible)]

message(
  "Using ", length(good_clusters),
  " of ", nrow(config_results2),
   " clusters (corrected RMSEA <= 0.06)"
)

fits <- cluster_lavaan_fits(config_results2)
items <- c("neu.1", "neu.2", "neu.3", "neu.4")
G <- length(good_clusters)

lambda <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = G, ncol = 4)
nu     <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = G, ncol = 4)
psi    <- rep(NA_real_, G)

rownames(lambda) <- good_clusters
rownames(nu)     <- good_clusters
colnames(lambda) <- items
colnames(nu)     <- items

for (i in seq_along(good_clusters)) {
  cl   <- good_clusters[i]
  fit_i <- fits[[as.character(cl)]]
  pa <- parameterEstimates(fit_i)

  psi_row <- pa[pa$lhs == "fw" & pa$op == "~~" & pa$rhs == "fw", ]
  if (psi_row$est[[1]] < 0) {
    warning("Negative latent variance for cluster ", cl, ": ", psi_row$est[[1]])
    next
  }
  psi[i] <- psi_row$est[[1]]

  for (j in seq_along(items)) {
    row <- pa[pa$lhs == "fw" & pa$op == "=~" & pa$rhs == items[j], ]
    lambda[i, j] <- row$est[[1]]
  }

  for (j in seq_along(items)) {
    row <- pa[pa$lhs == items[j] & pa$op == "~1" & pa$rhs == "", ]
    nu[i, j] <- row$est[[1]]
  }
}

# Standardize marker-identified loadings to unit factor variance for alignment.
lambda_std <- lambda * sqrt(psi)

alignment <- invariance.alignment(lambda = lambda_std, nu = nu, meth = 3)

summary(alignment)

# Aligned group-level factor variances (psi_g) and means (alpha_g)
alignment$pars$psi0
alignment$pars$alpha0
```

# 3. do once for each item (calculating the average latent variance of clusters for each of the item)
